testsuite.name: io.libp2p.protocol.PingConcurrentLifetimeTest

testcase.name: concurrent last closes and new registrations keep every captured scheduler usable()
concurrent failed protocol registrations release their scheduler references without affecting a sibling()
concurrent duplicate closes release only their own initiator()
a replacement scheduler serves a new root while the old executor is still terminating()
concurrent stream churn eventually terminates every default scheduler used()
a sole failed registration returns its captured scheduler()
